summary: Add a chat message field that holds @ chips

entries.summary: Add `PromptEditor`, a message field for a chat form that takes the place of a text area. Typing @ opens a menu of the app's `items`, and a picked item becomes a chip. Enter presses the form's Send button and does nothing while that button is disabled, Shift+Enter breaks the line, and Enter while an input method composes sends nothing. The message is the typed text with each chip as `<mention ref="…">label</mention>`, read through `value` and `onChange` or under `name` in the form's data. A pasted or dropped file goes to `onFiles` and never into the text. The demo is a chat form that sends through the AI SDK.
